title: Principal ai engineer - ai in healthcare
description:
WHO WE ARE
We are a stealth-stage healthcare AI startup that is the missing link in healthcare revenue management, bridging the gap between clinical care and financial operations. We're transforming how primary care clinics capture revenue through innovative AI technology that operates at the intersection of medical documentation, billing, and value-based care compliance.
In an industry where medical providers leave approximately 16% of their revenue uncollected due to insurance denials and compliance gaps, our mission is clear: enable healthcare providers to capture every dollar they've earned while uncovering new revenue opportunities.
Founded by experienced entrepreneurs with successful exits in healthcare technology and backed by advisors from leading health insurance companies, we are building a virtuous cycle that improves both patient care and provider profitability. We've already secured our first client contract and are positioned for a major pilot.
Our technology tackles critical challenges facing healthcare providers:
Real-time AI guidance for physicians at point-of-care
Automated coding and billing optimization
Intelligent claim follow-up to reduce denials
Seamless compliance with value-based care requirements
Join us as we build technology that enables healthcare providers to thrive in an era of value-based care, maximizing revenues in primary care at scale.
WHY THIS ROLE IS PERFECT FOR YOU
This is your opportunity to shape production LLM applications that directly impact healthcare revenue and patient care. You'll work on a recently deployed AI system that automates medical coding and billing, evolving it from good to exceptional through meticulous refinement, rigorous testing, and continuous improvement.
You're not just implementing AI solutions—you're building a system that must get medical coding right the first time, understand complex insurance rules that change constantly, learn from denials, and continuously improve. Every line of code you write directly affects whether healthcare providers get paid and patients receive proper care.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Very hands-on—we're looking for a builder who obsesses over details!
1. Build and Refine AI Products
Develop and implement new business rules for medical consultation billing codes, adapting to changes from various insurance providers
Propose and implement enhancements to our existing LLM-based products and optimize prompt engineering for maximum accuracy
Use AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor as part of your daily workflow to rapidly build and iterate on solutions
2. Ensure Quality and Accuracy
Conduct extensive testing in staging environments and perform detailed debugging to ensure business rules are accurately implemented—in healthcare, "mostly right" isn't good enough
Verify data consistency from input to output to guarantee the solidity of our AI products
Monitor denial patterns and implement feedback loops that continuously improve model accuracy
3. Own the Development Lifecycle
Be responsible for the entire process from understanding business rules to deploying and validating code in production
Debug complex system integrations and validate AI outputs against medical coding standards
4. Collaborate and Drive Improvement
Work closely with AI, Tech, and Data Engineering teams to maintain complete understanding of the end-to-end process
Proactively identify critical issues, propose improvements, and stay current with new tools and techniques in the AI and LLM space
In the near future, contribute to fine-tuning specialized LLM models with our internal knowledge base
REQUIRED EXPERTISE
1. Technical Skills
Strong proficiency in programming languages like Python or Go
Hands-on experience building products on top of large language models (LLMs)
Experience with LLM APIs (AWS Bedrock, Open AI, Anthropic Claude, or similar)
Strong prompt engineering skills with focus on accuracy and consistency
Solid understanding of how LLMs work and how to leverage them for production applications
Comfortable working with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and databases (Postgre SQL)
2. Mindset & Approach
Meticulous attention to detail with a strong capacity for debugging and code validation
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, ever-changing startup environment
Proven ability to learn new tools, frameworks, and business rules quickly
A self-starter who can work independently but also collaborate effectively within a small team
Possesses a "big picture" perspective, understanding how your work fits into the entire end-to-end process from client data entry to insurance billing
3. Highly Valued Qualifications
Experience with AI-assisted coding tools like Cursor, Git Hub Copilot, or similar
Experience working in a startup or similar environment with constant change
Familiarity with RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architectures
Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (Lang Chain, Llama Index, or similar)
Previous experience in healthcare technology, particularly with medical coding, billing, or revenue cycle management
Healthcare Domain Knowledge: Not required, but you must be willing and able to learn medical coding, billing rules, and insurance requirements quickly. We'll teach you what you need to know.
WHAT WE OFFER
1. Unparalleled Growth Opportunity
Ground-floor opportunity in a stealth-mode company with massive market potential
Direct impact on product direction and technical architecture decisions
Opportunity to build and lead a team as we scale
2. Professional Excellence
Work alongside world-class engineers and healthcare industry veterans
Access to cutting-edge LLM technologies solving complex, real-world problems
Opportunity to influence architectural decisions as we scale our AI infrastructure
Competitive compensation package with significant equity upside
3. Work-Life Integration
Fully remote position with flexible hours accommodating Brazil time zones
Fast-paced environment where you'll learn constantly and be challenged daily
Opportunity to work with prestigious American healthcare clients
Meaningful work that directly improves healthcare outcomes and provider sustainability
READY FOR THE CHALLENGE?
If you're a principal-level engineer who loves production AI systems, thrives on continuous improvement, obsesses over getting details right, and wants to make a real impact in healthcare, this role offers the perfect combination of technical challenge, business impact, and startup energy.
Apply now and help us transform healthcare revenue management through the power of data and AI.

Somos uma referência consolidada de 39 anos no mercado brasileiro na importação e distribuição de vinhos. Nosso portfólio possui mais de 400 rótulos de 70 produtores de 15 países, presentes em mais de 4.000 pontos de venda em todo o país. Você é uma pessoa naturalmente curiosa e orientada a resultados , que enxerga cada cliente como uma oportunidade única de encantamento. Tem a maturidade para trabalhar com autonomia na loja, buscando atingir suas metas, e a criatividade para criar experiências memoráveis para o consumidor, dentro de um ambiente que valoriza tanto a tradição quanto a evolução.

Visão estratégica: Enxerga o panorama completo da loja (metas, estoque, cliente) antes de agir. Adaptabilidade: Aprende rapidamente sobre novos rótulos e se reinventa conforme o fluxo de clientes. Proatividade: Antecipa necessidades do cliente e propõe soluções (harmonizações, presentes). Resiliência: Transforma um "não" ou um desafio (um cliente que não sabe o que quer) em uma oportunidade de fidelização.

Ele(a) é a "cara" da Zahil na loja, responsável por traduzir a complexidade e a história de cada garrafa em uma linguagem acessível e encantadora. É preciso ter agilidade para entender o que o cliente busca (muitas vezes, sem ele saber dizer), flexibilidade para navegar entre diferentes perfis de consumidores e uma vontade de aprender constantemente. Sua função é transformar o atendimento consultivo em resultados de vendas, fidelizando clientes e garantindo o bom funcionamento da loja.
Responsabilidades:

Prestar atendimento consultivo de excelência, identificando o perfil de gosto, ocasião e orçamento de cada cliente.
Analisar o perfil do cliente e apresentar os vinhos Zahil que possam se destacar e fazer a diferença na sua experiência.
Apoiar ativamente na prospecção de novos clientes na loja, assim como realizar "follow up" e pós-venda para clientes cadastrados.
Acompanhar as metas de vendas individuais e da loja (resultados, positivações) e propor ações para atingi-las.
Organizar e acompanhar degustações, "mini feiras" e eventos na loja, analisando o retorno de cada ação.
Garantir a organização do salão de vendas, incluindo reposição de produtos, precificação e Visual Merchandising.
Manter-se informado sobre todas as comunicações da Zahil, chegada de produtos, mudanças de preços, promoções e novas tabelas de trabalho.
Transmitir à gerência da loja as dificuldades, demandas dos clientes ou oportunidades de melhoria percebidas no dia a dia.
Apoiar no uso do sistema interno de faturamento da loja, CRM e no cadastro de clientes.
Qualificações e Experiência
Escolaridade: Desejável graduação completa ou curso técnico. Cursos: Curso de vinhos (técnico ou de extensão) é um forte diferencial. Idiomas: Desejável inglês e/ou espanhol (para atendimento a clientes estrangeiros). Experiência Profissional: Mínimo de dois anos em atendimento ao cliente e vendas(varejo).
Desejável: Experiência prévia no setor de vinhos (lojas, empórios, restaurantes).
Remuneração:
Regime CLT: R$ 3.000,00 (três mil reais) de salário fixo + comissão mensal
Benefícios: Vale Refeição/Alimentação, Vale Mobilidade e Plano médico Unimed
Pronto(a) para Fazer Parte da Nossa História?
Se você se identificou com nossa proposta e tem a ambição de contribuir para o crescimento de uma marca tradicional que busca inovação constante, queremos conhecer seu trabalho.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de planejamento e controle.

Contract

• Extensive experience with Snowflake or equivalent data warehouses for designing schemas, optimizing queries, and managing large datasets.
• Expertise in orchestration tools like Apache Airflow, with experience in building and managing complex workflows.
• Deep understanding of messaging queues such as Kafka, AWS SQS, or similar technologies for real-time data ingestion and processing.
• Demonstrated ability to architect and implement scalable data solutions handling terabytes of data.
• Hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg for managing and optimizing data lakes.
• Proficiency in containerization and orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes for deploying and managing distributed systems.

Demonstrated ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense , with sound judgment in escalation and decision-making. Strong knowledge of COAF, the Central Bank of Brazil, CVM regulations, and FATF recommendations.

Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or a related field; postgraduate studies or professional certifications (CAMS, ICA, etc.) strongly preferred.
Excellent analytical abilities, high ethical standards, and full professional fluency in Portuguese and English.

No history of bankruptcy or insolvency;

Strong understanding of the crypto industry, including market dynamics and associated risks;
Technical competence aligned with the responsibilities of the role.

Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;

title: Loyalty and subscription strategies manager
description:
Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan, a global giant in the delivery sector, and it's on an ambitious mission: to revolutionize the delivery of food and consumer goods worldwide. Our motto is simple yet powerful: “We help people eat better, live better.” Guided by this principle, we bring innovation and technology to the global stage. Keeta is in full expansion — and you could be part of this journey!
Location: 100% on site - Vila Olimpia, SP Please upload an English version of your resume.
About the Position We are looking for a strategic and creative professional to lead our Gamification & Subscription Strategies efforts. This role focuses on building innovative mechanisms such as missions, streaks, and loyalty programs that drive user engagement, as well as developing subscription-based models that strengthen recurrence and create long-term value. You will design, test, and scale programs that make our platform fun, sticky, and habit-forming, positioning us to compete head-to-head with established loyalty schemes in the market.
Responsibilities
Design and implement gamification strategies (progress bars, streaks, missions, rewards) that increase frequency and stickiness across user segments.
Develop and refine subscription models and loyalty programs that maximize user retention and LTV, while differentiating from competitor offerings.
Collaborate with CRM, Growth, and Product teams to integrate gamification mechanics into the user journey and app experience.
Conduct A/B testing and experimentation to evaluate the impact of gamified features and subscription perks on user behavior.
Monitor and analyze engagement metrics, progression funnel, and churn patterns to optimize program design and efficiency.
Partner with Data and Finance teams to build business cases for gamification and subscription initiatives, measuring ROI and long-term sustainability.
Explore partnerships with restaurants, brands, and third parties to enrich the subscription and gamification ecosystem.
Stay ahead of market trends and competitor strategies, ensuring our programs are locally relevant, innovative, and scalable.
Requirements
Bachelor’s degree or above in business, economics, engineering, or related fields.
Robust experience in user operations, loyalty, CRM, or product growth strategy in digital platforms.
Strong analytical skills, with proficiency in SQL, Python, or other tools to extract insights and validate impact.
Demonstrated experience in designing and scaling gamification or subscription programs.
Familiarity with user segmentation, behavioral psychology, and habit-forming product design.
Background in e-commerce, O2 O, food delivery, or subscription-based businesses preferred.
Strong project management and cross-functional leadership skills.
Creative, data-driven, and results-oriented, with the ability to balance user delight with business impact.
We hope to see you soon ;)

description:
Fundado em 2010 no Rio de Janeiro, o Instituto D’Or de Pesquisa e Ensino (IDOR) é uma organização sem fins lucrativos que tem como objetivo contribuir para a evolução da ciência, de forma a melhorar a condição de vida humana. Para isso, combina pesquisa de ponta, capacitação profissional e desenvolvimento tecnológico na área da saúde. Sua principal mantenedora é a Rede D’Or São Luiz (RDSL), maior rede hospitalar privada do Brasil.
Desde sua criação, o IDOR valoriza a ciência e se mantém atento às necessidades do país na área da saúde, mobilizando seus recursos e estimulando seus pesquisadores na busca de soluções para problemas atuais e futuros.
Desta forma, o Instituto trouxe importantes contribuições para a saúde pública nacional e internacional, como no entendimento do papel do vírus Zika nas malformações do sistema nervoso e nas pesquisas voltadas para o enfrentamento da pandemia de covid-19.
A excelência da pesquisa desenvolvida no IDOR viabiliza inúmeras parcerias internacionais e centenas de publicações em revistas científicas de grande prestígio. Além disso, o Instituto também contribui significativamente para a formação de profissionais da área da saúde nas diferentes esferas do ensino, incluindo graduação, pós-graduação stricto sensu, residência médica e multiprofissional, aperfeiçoamento e cursos de capacitação, atividades que deram origem à Faculdade IDOR de Ciências Médicas, fundada em 2017.

Atuamos na padronização de processos, execução de auditorias, monitoramento de indicadores e implementação de melhorias contínuas.

title: Business analyst
description:
THE ROLE
Love building things fast and figuring out what works? Curious about AI and excited to push the boundaries of what's possible? We're looking for a Business Analyst to join our Strategy team. You'll be our rapid prototyper---turning ideas into working features, testing what resonates, and handing off polished concepts to engineering for the full build. It's part builder, part thinker, and a whole lot of experimentation.
You'll work directly with the VP of Strategy and collaborate across product, engineering, and AI teams to bring new features to life quickly. If you're resourceful, creative, and love the thrill of "let's just try it and see," you'll thrive here.
WHAT YOU' LL DO:
Build fully functioning feature prototypes using AI tools like Claude Code and our platform
Test, iterate, and refine ideas with real users before they hit full production
Work backwards from customer problems to design solutions that actually solve them
Collaborate with engineers to hand off working prototypes for implementation
Stay curious about AI capabilities and explore creative ways to leverage them
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS
A knack for figuring things out---you don't need to know code, but you're not afraid to tinker
Strong product intuition and a bias toward action over perfection
Experience building, prototyping, or problem-solving in scrappy environments
Excellent communication skills---you can explain what you built and why it matters
Genuine interest in AI and emerging tools (exposure is a plus, enthusiasm is a must)
Bonus points for finance experience, but not required
Bonus points if you've worked with automation tools, no-code platforms, or AI assistants
Why Street Diligence?
We're The Deal Nerds making sense of complex contracts so our clients don't have to. But we're also builders who believe the best way to know if something works is to build it and test it. We move fast, we experiment often, and we're not afraid to try the unconventional approach. If you love the zero-to-one phase and want to shape how AI transforms financial intelligence, come join the crew.

description:
**To apply, kindly submit your resume in English. Please note that any other format will not be considered.**
Who we are:
Kajae is a premium staff augmentation company that connects top global talents to thriving US companies and clients offering fully remote opportunities. Our team hails from over 27 different countries, with the majority coming from the Philippines and Latin America. We pride ourselves on our tight-knit culture and strong bonds, despite working remotely across diverse timezones.
Benefits :
Competitive salary – paid in USD - Receive your compensation in US dollars, providing stability and global value for your hard work.
100% fully remote setup - Work from anywhere in the world—permanently. Enjoy the freedom and flexibility of a remote role while staying close to what matters most. No more commuting hassles, and more time for life’s important moments.
Healthy work-life balance - We prioritize your well-being. Through regular check-ins during your first few months, we offer ongoing support and career guidance. We also ensure you’re partnered with top-tier clients in a positive, healthy work environment.
Health insurance - Get covered starting your third month with us—your health and peace of mind matter.
Mental health support - Our in-house mental health professional is available to ensure you have access to the emotional and psychological support you need to thrive.
Referral bonuses - Know someone great? Refer them and earn up to USD 100 for every successful hire.
Fun virtual events - We host monthly virtual events filled with games, holiday celebrations, and exciting prizes. It’s a great way to connect and recharge as a team.
Kajae Spotlight bonus - Exceptional performance is recognized through our Kajae Spotlight program, where top performers earn cash rewards.
Kajae Tribe and rewards platform - Engage with the whole team through our internal social platform and earn coins for participating. Use them to bid in our lively auctions for prizes like Air Pods, Apple Watches, Starbucks gift cards, shopping or experience vouchers, and more.
Continuing education opportunities - Access 100% free online courses through our university partners in the US. Earn academic credits that can go toward a Master’s or Graduate Degree—completely on us.
All-expense paid summits - Top performers and tenured team members may qualify to attend our exclusive annual summits. So far, we’ve held summits in Palawan, Bohol, and Boracay (Philippines), Cusco (Peru), and Punta Cana (Dominican Republic).
About the Role
We are seeking a talented Net Suite Software Developer who is passionate about building scalable, high-performing applications that integrate seamlessly across business systems. The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in modern Java Script frameworks (Vue, React, or Angular) , Node JS backend development , and experience scripting within Net Suite . This position requires both creativity and technical depth to develop integrations, APIs, and dynamic web interfaces while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.
Responsibilities
Front-End Development: Build modern, responsive front-end interfaces using Vue.js (or similar frameworks such as React or Angular). Back-End Development: Develop and maintain robust Node JS services that handle data integration and automation. API Integration: Design, implement, and maintain RESTful API endpoints that connect enterprise systems. System Integration: Create and manage integrations between Net Suite and third-party platforms such as Business Central , Quick Books Online , and Salesforce . Net Suite Scripting: Develop and maintain Suite Script solutions to enhance Net Suite functionality and improve workflow efficiency. Collaboration: Work closely with project managers, designers, and other developers to solve complex technical challenges and ensure successful delivery.
Innovation: Continuously explore new technologies and methods to improve performance, scalability, and maintainability across systems.
Requirements:

Develop and maintain backend systems using Node.js and modern Java Script frameworks (Vue, Angular, or React).
Design and implement APIs, integrations, and backend logic for enterprise solutions.
Work with third-party APIs and enterprise systems to ensure seamless data flow.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.
Candidates must have a strong foundation in Net Suite , either as a Functional Consultant or Technical Consultant .
Nice to Have
Familiarity with accounting concepts or financial software. Experience with enterprise Saa S platforms (Net Suite, Salesforce, etc.). Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure, AWS). Background in ERP systems or business process automation. Experience with CRM integrations and data synchronization workflows.

Conheça um pouco sobre a Alliance One

A empresa conta com operações de produção de tabaco e de outras commodities em 14 países distribuídos nos 5 continentes, envolvendo cerca de 80 mil produtores contratados. Desde sua criação, vem se tornando referência em inovação, competitividade, vanguarda tecnológica e responsabilidade social, sempre com foco no desenvolvimento sustentável.
No Brasil conta, anualmente, com cerca de 3 mil empregados diretos, em todas as suas instalações. A capacidade instalada de processamento de tabaco nas unidades fabris da companhia é de 220 mil toneladas/ano.
Com atuação em cerca de 350 municípios, através de suas equipes de campo, a empresa investe forte na relação com seus 16 mil produtores integrados, sempre focada nos princípios e práticas de sustentabilidade.

title: Analista de ppcm florestal pl

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).
Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

title: Senior clinical data science programmer
description:
Senior Clinical Data Science Programmer - Remote - Brazil
ICON plc is a world-leading healthcare intelligence and clinical research organization. We’re proud to foster an inclusive environment driving innovation and excellence, and we welcome you to join us on our mission to shape the future of clinical development
We are currently seeking a Senior Clinical Data Science Programmer to join our diverse and dynamic team. You will contribute to the advancement of innovative treatments and therapies by ensuring the accuracy and efficiency of data processing through your programming expertise.

Act as mentor and provides guidance and support to more junior programmer levels assigned to a project. Assist in the development and implementation of improvements to technical systems and processes within an SME role. Provide guidance on programming best practices, coding standards, and data quality control measures. Stay updated on advancements in programming languages and data management tools to enhance operational efficiencies.
Your Profile: Complete bachelor’s degree relevant field such as computer science, SAS, statistics, or life sciences. Extensive experience in programming for CDMS (EDC systems such as Rave/Veeva), data validation outputs, data review/risk management outputs, custom reports, and programs in clinical trials with proficiency in languages such as SAS, R, or Python. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills, with a commitment to delivering high-quality results. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with diverse teams and influence outcomes. MUST HAVE advanced English Communication, Writing and Reading

Estamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sr com visão moderna, apaixonado(a) por tecnologia, inovação e pelo uso de Inteligência Artificial no desenvolvimento de soluções.
Se você busca desafios reais, autonomia e a chance de criar produtos que impactam milhares de pessoas, essa vaga é para você!
Atividades e Responsabilidades
Apoio técnico ao Product Manager, essencial execução de demandas de codificação e resolução de bloqueios junto ao time de desenvolvimento.
Principais Responsabilidades:
1. Desenvolvimento e Implementação: Você será responsável por desenvolver e implementar aplicações web de alta qualidade utilizando React JS/Vue.js,. NET e Node JS. Você deverá garantir que todas as aplicações sejam performáticas, escaláveis e mantidas adequadamente.
2. Construção de Componentes: Você será responsável por criar componentes reutilizáveis e funcionalidades para proporcionar a melhor experiência possível para o usuário. Isso inclui a construção, evolução e escalamento de arquiteturas distribuídas e micro serviços.
3. Code Review: Uma parte significativa de sua função será a participação em revisões de código para garantir a qualidade do código, a aplicação das melhores práticas e a eficiência na resolução de problemas.
4. Melhorias Contínuas: Você deverá propor constantemente melhorias nas soluções existentes para propiciar melhor desempenho, bem como acompanhar as novidades tecnológicas do ecossistema e proativamente sugerir mudanças que podem melhorar o processo de desenvolvimento. Isso pode incluir a adoção de novas ferramentas, técnicas de automação ou melhores práticas.
5. Implementação de CI/CD: Como parte do foco na eficiência e qualidade, você será responsável pela implementação de práticas de Integração Contínua e Entrega Contínua (CI/CD).
6. Testes: O desenvolvimento e aplicação de testes automatizados para garantir a qualidade e a integridade das aplicações serão uma parte fundamental de suas responsabilidades.
Requisitos
1. Experiência prévia comprovada em posição similar.
2. Proficiência em. NET, Vue.js/React JS e Node JS.
3. Experiência com Type Script.
4. Experiência com banco de dados relacional e não relacional.
5. Conhecimento com APIs REST.
6. Experiência com ferramentas de testes como Jest e Cypress.
7. Experiência em Docker e conteinerização de aplicações.
8. Experiência com sistemas de versionamento (Git) e pipelines de CI/CD.
9. Experiência com micro serviços e comunicação assíncrona com MQ (Ex: Rabbit MQ)
10. Conhecimento em estratégias de cache.
11. Conhecimento em Dev Ops e plataformas Cloud (Azure).
12. Conhecimento sólido em princípios do desenvolvimento de software, como design patterns, SOLID, e melhores práticas para softwares escaláveis.
13. Experiência em modelagem de domínio com DDD.
14. Excelente comunicação e habilidades de colaboração.
15. Conhecimento dos riscos comuns de segurança (OWASP).
16. Conhecimento em estratégias de monitoramento.
Diferenciais:
Conhecimentos em tecnologias de Inteligência Artificial no ambiente Azure ou GCP serão considerados um grande diferencial.

title: Salesforce developer omnistudio
description:
About OSF Digital:
OSF Digital is a leading global digital transformation company, operating in over 30 countries worldwide. As a Salesforce Partner , we specialize in providing innovative solutions to help businesses achieve their digital goals. We are proud to be the only global Salesforce partner recognized in the top 5 categories, highlighting our commitment to excellence and customer success. With a strong focus on leveraging cutting-edge technologies and industry best practices, our team of experts is dedicated to driving growth and efficiency for our clients across various industries. Embracing a 100% remote culture for over 20 years, we are committed to flexibility and work-life balance for our employees.
Join Our Team:
We are seeking a skilled Salesforce Developer with strong knowledge in Omni Studio to join our innovative team! The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing Salesforce solutions that meet our clients' needs, utilizing Omni Studio tools to create dynamic, customer-centric applications. If you are passionate about Salesforce development and eager to contribute to a dynamic team, we would love to hear from you!
Job Description:
Develop solutions using Omni Studio tools such as Omni Scripts, Data Raptors, Integration Procedures, and Flex Cards to build dynamic, customer-centric applications.
Collaborate with business analysts and stakeholders to understand functional requirements and translate them into technical designs.
Create technical specifications and designs for Omni Studio components that align with project objectives and Salesforce best practices.
Customize and configure the Salesforce platform using declarative tools to meet business needs, ensuring solutions are scalable and maintainable.
Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code using Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components, and other Salesforce technologies as needed.
Implement integrations with third-party systems using Salesforce APIs and middleware solutions.
Develop and execute comprehensive test plans, including unit tests, integration tests, and user acceptance testing to ensure the quality and functionality of the solutions.
Manage the deployment process using tools like Salesforce DX, change sets, or version control systems, ensuring smooth transitions from development to production environments.
Create detailed documentation for developed solutions, including design documents, user guides, and maintenance instructions.
Provide ongoing support and troubleshooting for deployed solutions, addressing any issues that arise in a timely manner.
Monitor and optimize the performance of Omni Studio solutions, ensuring they operate efficiently within Salesforce governor limits.
Work closely with project managers, other developers, and quality assurance teams to ensure timely delivery of high-quality solutions.
Engage with clients to gather feedback, understand their evolving needs, and make recommendations for enhancements or new features.
Share knowledge and best practices with the team, contributing to the collective expertise and professional development of colleagues.
Stay up-to-date with the latest Salesforce releases, Omni Studio updates, and industry trends to continuously improve skills and knowledge.
Ensure that all development work complies with company policies, industry standards, and Salesforce security guidelines.

title: Social content producer
description:
???????? Up to BRL 160,000 per year (depending on experience) on a full time, contractor contract
???? Fully remote working anywhere in Brazil!
???? Work with the latest high-end hardware and creative software.
???? You’ll develop your AI edge — we’ll help you use and deepen your skills with AI tools so you stay ahead of the curve, not left behind by how the industry is changing.
???? A culture where ideas matter — your suggestions shape how we work.
⚡ Fast, flexible, and innovative — we move like a start-up with the backing of a global team.
???? Be part of a global team of 200+ talented colleagues.
???? Working hours: 9am – 5:30pm Pacific Time Zone, with a 1 hr lunch break
Role Snapshot
A multi-skilled, hands-on creative role for a versatile storyteller and writer with a social-first brain.
You’ll be part of the creative engine on one high-profile entertainment account, spotting trends, pitching ideas, and turning TV and film moments into scroll-stopping social content. You’ll work day-to-day with other producers, editors and the Account Manager across multiple parts of the creative production process. You’ll ideate, coordinate, create, manage, write and deliver.
It’s a genuinely fast-paced agency environment with shifting priorities and tight deadlines, so you’ll need to enjoy that bit of pressure and stay calm and organized when things move quickly. You’ll also use AI in smart, safe ways to boost creativity and efficiency, keeping you ahead of the curve in this changing industry.
If you’re chronically online, obsessed with media and fandoms, love collaborating with others and excited to build upon your AI skills, we want to hear from you.
Who You Are
✅ Culture-obsessed creative & social-native storyteller: Chronically online, plugged into fandoms, memes and platform trends, and excited to turn them into smart ideas for TV and film IP. You think in hooks, formats and series, and understand how stories travel across different platforms.
✅ Resilient under pressure with high agency: You thrive in a fast-moving environment with shifting priorities and tight deadlines. You spot problems and opportunities and take ownership of your work, raising issues early and helping to fix or pursue them without waiting to be asked.
✅ Clear, confident communicator: Able to pitch ideas, give feedback and handle client comments calmly, clearly and constructively.
✅ Supportive team player: You’re comfortable collaborating within a small team, taking direction from senior colleagues, helping to keep everyone aligned and stepping up to lead parts of projects when needed.
✅ Organized producer: Strong on deadlines, details and juggling multiple titles at once, while keeping tools, calendars and asset libraries accurate.
✅ AI-fluent creator: You already use AI tools and LLMs to boost your creativity and speed, and you’re curious about weaving them into everyday workflows.
✅ Driven by doing great work: Energized by smart, well-crafted content, proud of the output, and focused on delivering for both clients and fans.
Not required but nice to haves: Experience in social-first production — creating or producing content specifically for social channels. Copywriting experience — writing creatively for any platform that showcases a strong tone of voice. Entertainment or fandom experience — working on film/TV, streaming, gaming or other fandom-heavy brands.
Hands-on creative skills — basic design, editing or motion skills.
Who We Are
At Storm Ideas, we supercharge the digital presence of some of the biggest names in US TV and entertainment. Since 2008, our international team has delivered bold, forward-thinking solutions for globally recognised clients.
Whether we're building innovative products, producing high-impact social content, or designing smarter ways for our partners to work—we’re right at the cutting edge of creativity, technology, and automation.
Embracing Future-Facing Technology
Emerging technologies like Artificial Intelligence present exciting opportunities for us and our clients. As the world adapts, we’re committed to safely exploring the potential advantages of AI, integrating it thoughtfully into our work where possible, and one day guiding our clients through new possibilities when they’re open and ready for them. By tapping into our creativity, expertise, and collaboration, we aim to embrace its potential together. Our vision relies on people who are curious about this technology and excited to take on this challenge!
What You’ll Make Happen
Own day-to-day production for creative ideas you pitch, turning brand priorities, fandom insights and social trends into clear, platform-native and reactive content ideas across platforms.
Lead and contribute to brainstorms, shaping ideas into repeatable concepts or one-off reactive executions that feel right for each platform and audience.
Turn ideas into tight, practical briefs for editors, motion designers and art directors — with clear references, formats, specs, timings and deliverable lists.
Manage the content pipeline for your pitches: source and organize footage and assets, brief work in, track progress, flag risks early and keep delivery on schedule.
Keep our tools and trackers accurate (e.g. Airtable, content calendars, asset libraries), suggesting improvements that make the workflow smoother and more efficient.
Work directly with clients on your projects, presenting ideas, gathering and interpreting feedback, and adjusting outputs while protecting the strength of the creative.
Create social-first content yourself: writing platform-specific copy (captions, overlays, CTAs, post text) and producing simple visual assets ready for publishing.
Comb through episodes, films, trailers and clips to surface the strongest social moments, tagging and timecoding them into clear hooks and formats for editors and designers to build from.
Run rigorous quality checks on assets before delivery to ensure they’re on-brand, accurate, compliant and optimized for each platform’s specs and best practices.
Collaborate closely with the wider team, sharing context between strategy, creative, production and account management so everyone is clear on priorities and next steps.
Use AI tools and LLMs to boost your output, from idea generation and copy exploration to asset variations and tagging, and contribute to evolving how we use AI in our workflows.
Application
Along with your CV, please send us a cover letter that tells us why you’re the perfect fit for this role, PLUS, make us a meme! Try your best to make us laugh with a simple text-on-image meme using TV or Film IP. We’d also LOVE if you could let us know your current favourite social media trend and why!
RECRUITMENT PROCESS
Initial Video Questions If shortlisted, you’ll be invited to complete a short set of questions via our online video platform.
First Interview You’ll then have an interview with a member of our recruitment team to discuss your experience, skills, and interest in the role.
Creative Task (if applicable) We may ask you to prepare a few creative ideas or examples of your work ahead of the next stage.
Final Interview The final stage will be an interview with Louise Sables, our CEO and Nina Bicket, Head of Content Production. This is your opportunity to talk in more depth about your creative approach and how you could contribute to our team.
Not sure if you tick every box? Apply anyway — we value potential, mindset, and ambition as much as experience.

title: Diretor de arte
description:
Quem somos?
Somos um grupo brasileiro de tecnologia e entretenimento digital que está transformando o mercado de apostas online com inovação, ética e foco total na experiência do jogador e dos nossos colaboradores, pois aqui tudo gira em torno de pessoas.
Nosso propósito vai além de odds e estatísticas. Criamos plataformas seguras, transparentes e envolventes para quem busca comunidade, conexão e uma experiência real.
Somos detentoras das marcas Reals e UX Group duas plataformas independentes que se complementam e compartilham o mesmo objetivo: elevar o padrão do setor de apostas online no Brasil.
???? Nosso jeito de ser
Aqui, nossos valores guiam tudo o que fazemos: somos movidos por excelência com velocidade , inovação com propósit o e foco real em gente – clientes e time no centro de tudo. Valorizamos quem tem fome de vencer , age com responsabilidade e constrói com transparência .
Na prática, isso significa crescer junto, aprender rápido e f azer acontecer com ética e consistência . Se você acredita que entretenimento, inovação e responsabilidade podem (e devem) caminhar juntos, vem com a gente?!
???? Como é trabalhar aqui
Trabalhar na UX GROUP é estar num ambiente onde as coisas acontecem rápido, com muita troca, liberdade e gente com brilho no olho.
Você vai encontrar:

Time acessível e zero burocracia
Ambiente seguro pra ser quem você é
Liberdade com responsabilidade
Cultura de reconhecimento de verdade
Espaço pra testar, errar, aprender e crescer
Tecnologia, atitude e impacto no centro de tudo
Aqui, quem faz acontecer tem espaço pra brilhar .
Como Diretor de Arte , você será responsável por liderar a construção visual das campanhas e projetos da UX group, garantindo que cada entrega traduza a essência da marca com criatividade, consistência e impacto.
Você atuará desde a concepção até a execução de peças visuais para campanhas de grande escala, como torneios digitais, ativações em estádios e ações com celebridades, sempre alinhado à estratégia de marketing e branding da empresa. Será seu papel transformar conceitos em experiências visuais memoráveis, conectando a marca ao público de forma autêntica e inovadora.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Liderar o time de criação com orientação técnica e visão inspiradora;
Criar, aprovar e refinar campanhas visuais 360° (branding, mídia, digital, produto, influenciadores, redes sociais);
Implementar fluxos de trabalho criativos com IA (como Midjourney, Chat GPT, etc) para acelerar ideias, gerar referências e escalar produção;
Conhecimento em web design, criação de landing pages, interfaces de produto;
Supervisionar criações em 3 D, motion graphics e visual futurista, aplicando estética de alto impacto e referência global;
Gerenciar um pipeline de entregas com múltiplas demandas e prazos curtos;
Coordenar freelancers e fornecedores externos com olhar crítico e excelência;
Participar da estratégia criativa com a liderança da empresa, garantindo coesão entre campanhas e objetivos de negócio;
Trazer benchmarks, provocar o time e manter o padrão visual no mais alto nível;
Liderar a criação e evolução de guidelines visuais, sistemas e identidade da marca.
Requisitos e qualificações

Experiência sólida como Diretor(a) de Arte em ambientes de alta performance;
Portfólio com campanhas visuais fortes, foco digital e entregas multiformato;
Experiência comprovada com liderança de time criativo (feedback, gestão, processos);
Domínio em Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, ferramentas de prototipação e motion;
Conhecimento prático em ferramentas de IA aplicadas à criação (imagem, vídeo, texto, automações criativas);
Experiência com 3 D (Blender, Cinema 4 D, ou similares) e visual de alto impacto;

title: Coordenador gerenciamento de riscos rj
description:
Buscamos um profissional para atuar como COORDENADOR GERENCIAMENTO DE RISCOS em um dos maiores provedores de serviços logísticos do País e um dos principais Players internacionais em seu segmento.
Será responsável por coordenar e acompanhar os processos de avarias, por meio da análise de incidentes e Termos de Ocorrência, propondo melhorias operacionais.
REQUISITOS:
Ensino superior em Administração, Engenharia, Logística, Gestão de Riscos ou áreas correlatas;
Pós-graduação ou certificações em gestão de riscos, segurança ou áreas afins;
Experiência com sistemas de monitoramento e tecnologia de rastreamento;
Experiência comprovada em gerenciamento de riscos, no setor de transporte;
Experiência em torre de controle, monitoramento dos caminhões, chegada, saída, ocorrências;
Experiência em acionar seguro, acompanhar sinistro junto à seguradora, reportar as ocorrências e soluções ao corpo diretivo da empresa.
Conhecimento das normas de segurança e legislação vigente;
Habilidade para liderar equipes multidisciplinares;
Excelentes capacidades de comunicação, organização e tomada de decisão;
Excel avançado.
Conhecimentos de Power BI;
Conhecimentos de conceitos Kaizen;
Conhecimentos de bancos de dados e estatística;
RESPONSABILIDADES:
Desenvolver, implementar e monitorar políticas e procedimentos de gerenciamento de riscos;
Identificar, avaliar e propor soluções para mitigar riscos operacionais, financeiros e regulatórios;
Realizar auditorias internas e análises de conformidade;
Treinar equipes sobre práticas de segurança e prevenção de riscos;
Elaborar relatórios periódicos para a diretoria e demais áreas envolvidas;
Atuar diretamente na gestão de crises e incidentes, propondo planos de ação eficazes.
Desenvolver e orientar a confecção de relatórios estatísticos de avarias e sinistros, através do levantamento das informações, visando fornecer subsídios para tomada de decisão; negociar com clientes, terceiros e seguradoras, os valores de indenização a serem pagos ou reembolsados, decorrentes dos danos ocorridos nas cargas;
Atender à fiscalização de órgãos públicos, dirimindo dúvidas, negociando pendências e esclarecendo procedimentos com o objetivo de atender às necessidades legais;
Atuar diretamente com a empresa corretora de seguros nos casos de renovação de apólice, abertura de sinistros, indenizações, salvados e encerramento do sinistro, preenchendo formulários, encaminhando documentações e prestando as informações necessárias;
Contribuir na garantia da execução dos processos existentes na área e instruir quanto aos procedimentos executados, visando otimizar as informações prestadas e atender à legislação e os prazos estabelecidos;
Planejar ações que visam à redução de perdas e danos ao patrimônio da empresa, mediante a análise e avaliação de situações que representam riscos aos bens da empresa e clientes;
Proceder com a emissão de comunicados aos clientes e seguradoras a respeito dos sinistros ocorridos, informando sobre o andamento dos processos, visando à atualização dos dados e decisões da empresa;
REMUNERAÇÃ O:
Compatível com o mercado; Pacote de Benefícios completo!
LOCAL DE TRABALHO :
Rio de Janeiro - RJ
